independence_and_selection_caveats: This three-item check is selected to inspect known disagreements and is not a representative test set.
These Wiktionary entries are source-attested, not independently adjudicated by a language expert; do not promote them to gold labels automatically.

FastThaiG2P upstream describes Wiktionary-derived dictionary entries, and thaiphon reports a Wiktionary-derived etalon, so source overlap/circularity is plausible. The 3/3 concordance is therefore not an independent accuracy estimate.
String mismatch can reflect IPA convention, affricate tie-bar normalization or segmentation as well as phonological error; review raw output before any normalization.
